title: 第二十六章     再次出手
content_zh:
有些女生就是喜欢那种高高在上被所有人都追求的感觉，这个爱慕虚荣的妹子也一样，并没有把身后的人都赶走，反而是借机又勾搭了一个富二代，于是这件事情就陷入到了这种死循环，苏林依和孙依诗没事儿的时候也会聊上几句，但是这一次看苏林依的样子显然是有更加好玩的事情发生。

    “今天那个妹子跑到我们班之后竟然和咱们学校的校草表白了。”苏林依虽然话说出来是带着惊讶的，但是语气里面却一点惊讶的意思都没有，平铺直叙的就像是见怪不怪一样。

    “我的天啊，这妹子还真是胆大，谁不知道咱们学校的校草那是出了名的高冷，而且家世背景根本就不是她能够高攀得起的啊，真不知道这个妹子到底是哪里来的勇气。”孙依诗无语的说到，语气也很无奈，归根结底就是想不明白这个妹子是不是脑子进水了才敢和高冷的小草表白，而且校草这种东西根本就是个只能远观不能近玩的物种啊。

    “你先别急者下定论啊，更好玩的事情还在后面。”苏林依故作神秘地说道。

    “你可不要告诉我校草答应了，不然的话你这个校花可要怎么办才好啊。”孙依诗一脸担忧的样子，但是一看就知道这分明就是装出来的，苏林依的终身大事根本就不用担心，只要是苏林依说一声她想要嫁人，孙依诗敢保证，前来求婚的人绝对能够从市中心一直排到隔壁省！

    “没没没，他怎么会答应，不过事先说好啊，他和我可一点关系都没有，但是今天校草做的事儿，还真是震惊到了所有人，他居然一声不吭直接站起来走到一个小姑娘身边一把拉起人家就亲上去了，然后还酷酷的说道‘看见了吗？我家的。’然后带着那个已经吓傻了的妹子直接就走了。”

    苏林依越说越起劲，今天的最好玩的事情并不是校草被人表白，也不是校草被那个飞扬跋扈的妹子表白，更多的是校草那个万年禁欲大冰山竟然能够喜欢一个人！这才是最震惊的，苏林依和孙依诗的教养告诉他们就算是别人在奇葩嘲笑也是不对的，最多偷笑就好了，但是校草和那个小姑娘在这一起这种开心高兴的事情还是很值得谈论一番的。

    “那个小姑娘是谁啊？应该不会是什么籍籍无名的妹子吧？”孙依诗已经猜到了苏林依今天的套路，要是那个妹子真的是平凡到不行的话，苏林依才不会有那么多的铺垫呢。

    “那妹子就是学校里的大学霸啊，天天除了书本就连吃饭都不会多看饭一眼的神奇存在。”苏林依觉得这样的妹子还真是有定力有深度，一定是个知识渊博修养很好的女孩儿。

    而孙依诗听到这个事情之后连连点头，一副很有深度的样子说道：“那么这件事情就没有什么好奇怪的了，咱们学校的两大奇葩在一起绝对是配的不能够再配了，你看看啊，一个要身高有身高要颜值有颜值要钱有钱，一个要智商有智商，要学识有学识，而且也是要颜值有颜值，他们两个要是不在一起的话，简直就是天理难容啊。”

    孙依诗叹了口气又说道：“不过学霸妹子平时那么低调，真不知道校草是不是学了什么淘金术，能从这么多的沙子里面挖一块宝贝出来，还真是难为他了，而且那个霸道总裁的样子真是帅得不得聊啊。”孙依诗一脸星星眼。

    陈木面无表情的听着两个人的对话，已经是风中凌乱了，完全听不懂两个人讨论问题的关键在哪里，更何况他们两个说的很多的词语什么的陈木根本就没有听过啊，这种感觉还真是糟糕透顶啊。

    不过陈木觉得听两个女孩子聊天什么的也不是太好，毕竟他们说的自己根本就没有插上话的机会，还是默默地吃着炸鸡好了。
content_en:
Some girls just like the feeling of being aloof and being pursued by everyone. This vain girl is the same. Instead of driving away everyone behind her, she took the opportunity to hook up with a rich second generation, so the matter fell into an endless loop. Su Linyi and Sun Yishi would chat a few words when they had nothing to do, but this time Su Linyi looked like something more interesting was going on.

    "Today that girl came to our class and confessed her love to the president of our school." Although Su Linyi said it with surprise, there was no surprise in his tone. He spoke plainly, as if he was not surprised.

    "Oh my god, this girl is so brave. Who doesn't know that the school hunk in our school is famous for being cold and cold, and her family background is beyond her reach? I really don't know where this girl got her courage." Sun Yishi said speechlessly and her tone was helpless. In the final analysis, she couldn't figure out whether this girl was out of her mind before she dared to confess to the aloof Xiaocao. Moreover, the school grass was simply a species that could only be viewed from a distance and not played with up close.

    "Don't rush to a conclusion yet, the more interesting things are yet to come." Su Linyi said pretending to be mysterious.

    "Don't tell me that the school sweetheart has agreed, otherwise what will you, the school belle, do?" Sun Yishi looked worried, but at a glance she knew it was just an act. There was no need to worry about Su Linyi's life-long events. As long as Su Linyi said she wanted to get married, Sun Yishi could guarantee that the number of suitors would line up from the city center to the next province!

    "No, no, no, no, no, no, how could he agree, but we had agreed in advance that he and I have nothing to do with each other, but what the school girl did today really shocked everyone. He actually stood up without saying a word, walked over to a little girl, pulled her up and kissed her, and then said coolly, 'Did you see it? It's from my family.' Then he took the girl who was already scared and left directly."

    Su Linyi became more and more enthusiastic as she spoke. The most interesting thing today was not that the school sweetheart was confessed by someone, nor was it that the school sweetheart was confessed by that domineering girl. What was more, the school sweetheart, the iceberg who had been abstaining from sex for ten thousand years, could actually like someone! This was the most shocking thing. The upbringing of Su Linyi and Sun Yishi taught them that it was wrong to laugh at others, and they could just snicker at most. But the happy thing about the school girl and the little girl being together is still worth talking about.

    "Who is that little girl? She can't be some unknown girl, right?" Sun Yishi had already guessed Su Linyi's routine today. If that girl was really ordinary, Su Linyi wouldn't have so much foreshadowing.

    "That girl is the top student in the school. She is a magical being who doesn't even take a second look at the meal except for books every day." Su Linyi felt that such a girl is really determined and deep, and must be a girl who is knowledgeable and well-educated.

    After hearing this, Sun Yishi nodded repeatedly and said with a profound look: "Then there is nothing strange about this matter. The two weirdos in our school are absolutely perfect for each other. Look, one needs to be tall, good-looking, and rich, and the other needs to have IQ, knowledge, knowledge, and good looks. If the two of them are not together, it will be unforgivable."

    Sun Yishi sighed and added: "But the top school girl is usually so low-key. I really wonder if the school girl has learned some gold mining skills. It's really difficult for her to dig out a treasure from so much sand. And the domineering president is so handsome." Sun Yishi looked starry-eyed.

    Chen Mu listened to the conversation between the two people expressionlessly. He was already messy in the wind. He couldn't understand the key point of the discussion between the two people. What's more, Chen Mu had never heard a lot of words they said. This feeling was really terrible.

    However, Chen Mu felt that it was not good to listen to two girls chatting. After all, they said that he had no chance to interrupt, so he would just eat fried chicken in silence.
